body_markdown:
**Panorama for Skyward Now Available to Eligible Washington School Districts Through WSIPC**


**New offering makes Panorama Education’s MTSS, survey, and AI-powered student-support tools available to eligible Washington districts through WSIPC’s existing Skyward agreement.**


**EVERETT, Wash. — October 20, 2026**


— The Washington School Information Processing Cooperative (WSIPC) and Skyward™ are expanding the solutions available to Washington school districts with


**Panorama for Skyward,**


a new product offering that allows eligible districts to purchase Panorama Education’s student support platform through WSIPC. It is an additional product purchase that can be added to a district's existing Skyward agreement.


Through Panorama for Skyward, participating districts can use designated student data already maintained in Skyward within Panorama’s platform, which connects MTSS, surveys, and secure, district-aligned AI. Panorama for Skyward brings together academic, attendance, behavior, intervention, and other student information in one place, giving districts a more complete picture of student needs, so they can easily identify where support is needed, coordinate interventions, and track progress over time.


North Kitsap School District, which already uses Panorama alongside Skyward, has experienced the value of bringing the two systems together and sees an opportunity to extend those benefits to more Washington districts.


“Panorama has become an essential part of how North Kitsap School District strives to ensure every student receives the appropriate support for their unique needs,” said Dr. Jeremy Sullivan, Director of Innovative Learning and Student Supports. “By bringing meaningful student data together in one view, our teams can make more informed, timely decisions that strengthen our Multi-Tiered System of Supports. Panorama for Skyward can help more Washington schools turn data into meaningful action, so every student is seen, supported, and successful.”


Skyward remains the district’s student information system and system of record. Panorama for Skyward is an integrated platform that works alongside Skyward, using designated Skyward data within Panorama’s student support tools. WSIPC provides the Cooperative purchasing and contractual pathway for eligible Washington districts.


“One of our strategic pillars is ensuring client success,” said Dr. Dana Anderson, CEO of WSIPC. “When districts identify shared needs, we look for tools and resources that can help address them. Our districts have been clear about the need to strengthen MTSS practices and better support student learning and opportunity. Panorama for Skyward gives districts another option to help meet that need.”


The offering comes as Washington school districts continue strengthening MTSS practices, intervention tracking, and student support systems while preparing for evolving state expectations.


“Through our partnerships with Washington districts, we’ve seen firsthand the incredible work educators are doing to make sure every student gets the support and services they need,” said Aaron Feuer, CEO and co-founder of Panorama Education. “We’re proud to be part of that work, and we’re excited to deepen our commitment to Washington alongside WSIPC and Skyward—reaching more districts and helping more students thrive.”


Panorama Education will lead implementation, training, and product support during the initial phase of the partnership. WSIPC, Skyward, and Panorama will work together to support Washington districts, monitor the customer experience, and develop the longer-term support model.


Additional information about Panorama for Skyward, including available packages, implementation, and how WSIPC districts can learn more, will be available


[here](https://www.panoramaed.com/partnerships/panorama-for-skyward) .


**About Panorama Education**


Panorama Education is the leading platform for student support and learning, helping K-12 districts use data and secure AI to understand student needs and take effective action. Panorama enables better decisions and improved outcomes for more than 15 million students nationwide across MTSS, instruction, surveys, special education, and graduation pathways. Learn more at


[panoramaed.com](http://www.panoramaed.com/) .


**About Skyward**


Since 1980, Skyward has provided student information system (SIS) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions that help K–12 districts streamline operations, connect with families, and support student success. Serving more than 2,500 school districts, Skyward combines technology developed with input from educators and administrators with personalized customer support. Learn more at


[skyward.com](https://www.skyward.com/) .


**About WSIPC**


Founded in 1967, the Washington School Information Processing Cooperative (WSIPC) is a public agency formed by Washington state’s nine Educational Service Districts (ESDs). WSIPC serves more than 300 school districts across Washington, providing technology solutions, shared services, and cooperative purchasing opportunities that help educational organizations operate more efficiently and effectively. Through collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to service, WSIPC helps schools and districts focus on what matters most: student success. Learn more at


[wsipc.org](https://www.wsipc.org/) .
